verdict.rationale: Vue's reactivity system (vue-docs-4) and community praise for its ergonomic state API (vue-comm-3) suggest built-in reactive primitives could serve as a lightweight global store, but the evidence pack never documents this specific pattern (e.g. using reactive()/ref() as a store) — instead it highlights Vuex, an official but separate library, as the state-management solution (vue-comm-10, vue-comm-14). missing for 10: explicit docs or examples of using built-in reactive()/ref() for cross-component global state without Vuex/Pinia, independent corroboration of this pattern in production apps.
